evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Addresses long-standing consensus-level vulnerabilities including quadratic legacy sigop CPU exhaustion, Merkle tree leaf-internal collision (CVE-2017-12842), and timewarp difficulty manipulation. Establishing this implementation upstream is category-critical to allow testing, evaluation, and eventual deployment decisions for the consensus cleanup soft fork.
